sloka: स कुम्भकर्णो हृतकर्णनासो विदारितस्तेन विमर्दितश्च।रोषाभिभूतः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः सुग्रीवमाविध्य पिपेष भूमौ ।। ६.६७.८८ ।।
transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇo hṛtakarṇanāso vidāritastena vimarditaśca।roṣābhibhūtaḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ sugrīvamāvidhya pipeṣa bhūmau ।। 6.67.88 ।।

translations.english: There after the king of Vanaras decided to act and tore off the ears of the enemy ruler of gods (Kumbhakarna) with his sharp nails, bit off the nose with his teeth, and sides of Kumbhakarna.
